Appointment Sync: Status updates sync every 15 minutes via API; final testing pending to ensure accurate Go High Level visibility.
Marketing Attribution: Source overwrite removed; "Next Gen Sync" tag added to preserve original campaign data like Google/Meta Ads.
WhatsApp Shift: WhatsApp integration pending IT call; automation workflows on hold until WhatsApp replaces SMS for messaging.
Reactivation Campaign: Logic built for 150,000 leads but depends on WhatsApp completion for effective client engagement.

meetings_digest.title: Monique Reyes and Flow Company
key_points: Fragmented Marketing Vendors: Elgin uses four marketing companies leading to scattered efforts and subpar 2-3x ROI over six months.
Consolidation Proposal: Flowco offers unified marketing with expert teams and HIPAA-compliant EMR integration for real-time tracking.
Tracking and Reporting Issues: Current mix of Excel, Slack, and AI dashboards causes poor visibility; Flowco aims for a single unified dashboard.
New Practice Challenges: Elgin Dental Implants started under a year ago, experimenting with seven marketing firms, showing need for stable strategy.
Integration Complexity: Middleware mirrors EMR scheduling, overcoming common dental API issues to ensure accurate lead-to-patient data flow.
action_items: Sohib Boundaoui
Provide a tailored overview and presentation addressing Elgin Dental Implants’ current marketing setup and how Flow Company’s consolidated approach can improve integration and ROI (08:02)
Elgin Dental Implants
Review and decide which two underperforming marketing firms to drop and communicate changes internally (05:36)
